rationale: This law review article analyzes the history, policy, and legal framework of American Indian health care. It clearly fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4 because the topic is health care policy rather than household or community water or sanitation service access.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the article examines legal, policy, and institutional frameworks (satisfying plain Criterion 2 in the abstract), it addresses Indian health care rather than household or community water or sanitation service access, so the screening decision is exclude under both the narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2.

evidence_quotes.quote: Learning How to Heal: An Analysis of the History, Policy, and Framework of Indian Health Care
American Indian Law Review, Vol. 20, No. 2 (1995/1996), pp. 365-397
